seoDescription.en: High-resolution, zoomable Taipei Metro (MRT) map for 2026 by Metliner. Explore every line and station across Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan and Keelung in one clean, unified design.
seoDescription.zh: Metliner 設計的高解析、可縮放台北捷運路線圖 2026。涵蓋台北、新北、桃園、基隆的完整軌道路網。

intro.en: Taipei, the vibrant capital of Taiwan, boasts a modern and efficient public transportation system, with its railway network playing a central role. From the bustling Taipei Main Station to the sleek high-speed rail, Taipei's railways connect the city and the island, offering convenient and comfortable travel experiences.
intro.zh: 台北是台灣充滿活力的首都，擁有現代且高效的大眾運輸系統，軌道路網在其中扮演核心角色。從繁忙的台北車站到便捷的高速鐵路，台北的鐵道連結著城市與整座島嶼，帶來便利舒適的旅行體驗。
